notes: Only one rival is visible per turn, so the observed block is thin: austria sees Korea, iroquois sees Korea, korea sees Austria, siam sees Korea.
No seat ever observes Iroquois, Siam, so those civs never appear in a rivals block and their era is never recorded.
No seat observation carries that seat's own era (era appears only in the rival visible line), so series entries have no era field and no eraSequence is emitted.
korea is sparse: 53 readable turns across turns 1 to 211, so its per-turn rates and second-city timing are coarse.
The text reads "undefined" for 1 turn of gold per turn, 4 turns of research, 3 turns of the policy countdown, and those fields are omitted rather than guessed.
Gold per turn is negative in 5 turns, which the text writes as "+-N/turn".
A countdown can read negative (1 entry does), which is the engine rounding an almost finished item.
Rival research reads "undefined" in 11 observed turns, which drops the research fields on those rival entries.
City counts fall as well as rise (3 drops), so citiesAdded is a net change and not a count of foundings.
Seat records do not share a start turn (first turns 0, 1), because turn 0 is the opening state for most seats while the Korea record opens at turn 1.
Research and policy counts are the engine's own projections, so they drift as science and culture change and are not fixed durations.
